task.goal: Add the expenses from expenses.jpg in Simple Gallery Pro to pro expense.
task.final_summary: I added all three expenses from expenses.jpg to Pro Expense. School Supplies for $441.58 under Education with the note "Paid by card", Video Games for $196.73 under Entertainment with the note "Urgent", and Home Insurance for $304.65 under Housing with the note "Want to have". The app's home total now reads 942.96 USD, matching the three amounts.
